acceptanceCriteria: A 1.0.0-rc.2 candidate built from a main carrying decision 0427's context changes has retained install-lifecycle qualification on at least darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64.

benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/harness.py run executes once each against urfave/cli (pin 7389061e, preregistration eedf799f), Corvint (loop target a5a7412c) and beamfall/core with the sealed preregistrations; run files and receipts are committed whatever the verdict.
README's Core jobs row and docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md state the three job verdicts from those runs, and V1-0019, V1-0431 and V1-0433 are closed or re-scoped from the result.
body: Decision 0427 / docs/build-log/2026-10-01-unproven-rows-root-causes.md. The go-chi/chi orientation corpus (development since decision 0425) scores 0 treatment-only critical misses over 20 cases with the rank-relative counterpart rule (TCP-V0-004) and the default anchor field (TCP-V0-022), against 4 on main and 3 at rc.1. The V1-0432/V1-0433 harness and loop-target fixes are on main. Row 3 of README's status table changes only to what the sealed cobra and Corvint runs report. The urfave/cli, Corvint and beamfall/core preregistrations target 1.0.0-rc.2 with harness b67cc95a; the candidate must be a verified release-artifact directory whose --version reads Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2. 2026-10-05: decision 0432 (prepared as 0427 on 2026-09-29) replaces spf13/cobra with urfave/cli at pin 7389061e because cobra's exact pin was already scored in retained development results; the cobra preregistration is retained unchanged and not run. Rc.2 signing policy: decision 0433 (no signing, SHA256SUMS only, publisher identity NOT_VERIFIED).

completion.reason: 1.0.0-rc.2 (b7b21205, build 360) published 2026-10-06 with install-lifecycle qualification on darwin/arm64 and hosted linux/amd64 (release-gate run 37466658604; same-bytes and N-1 from rc.1) per docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md (sha256 ec3ab7e5c3e400889c21bb7047cc47a6456e455d18ea4e80b12c09c06ea1a1b2). Harness runs on urfave/cli, Corvint and beamfall/core committed in #631 (docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0019-rc2-runs.md, sha256 ac1402f7080c927cf9ae8a8bd61583ef90c655756ee466f1830ea90a2c9a601d). Verdicts: orientation FAILED on all three, consequence and completion PASSED; stated in README Core jobs row (beamfall/corvint#634 merged at 2cea1bfba240d5d41cdb80535bff1ee4ac0f2942, README sha256 f73cab3c5dab6a03c299fb6c261bb9419267aa97e294ac615ff94dae482f7489) and RELEASE-NOTES. V1-0019 and V1-0431 re-scoped with the rc.2 result; V1-0433 closed. Follow-up orientation fix tracked as V1-0859.

title: Build 1.0.0-rc.2 and run the untouched-repository Core jobs on urfave/cli, Corvint and beamfall/core
